objective: Reduce Material/PBR and critical materially-impossible-value risk by making actual active Unity materials and renderer bindings conform to the construction/lookdev metadata rather than merely documenting plausible values.

commits.summary: Added actual-scene material physicality binding and validation for benchmark-facing danchi parts.
Added machine-readable scene material physicality/manufacture contract, including period-plausible rigid PVC-U downpipe reasoning.
Added quality-scene save gate so material-family/value mismatches cannot persist after the detailed benchmark chain exists.
Bound material physicality contract and active-scene validation into the complete native-4K review packet.

findingsAndCorrections.finding: MAT_AgedAluminum was generated at metallic=0.55 although the existing construction registry specifies aged anodized aluminium metallic range 0.70-1.00.
findingsAndCorrections.correction: Final physicality pass sets the actual Unity material to metallic=0.85 and smoothness=0.50, then validates active sash/rail bindings.

findingsAndCorrections.finding: MAT_DarkGalvanizedSteel was generated at metallic=0.62 although the existing registry specifies galvanized steel metallic range 0.75-1.00.
findingsAndCorrections.correction: Final physicality pass sets metallic=0.88 and smoothness=0.40, disables emission, and validates rail anchorage/downpipe clamp bindings.

findingsAndCorrections.finding: Base RailTop_* and Rail_* members used a mid-metallic legacy Rail material despite the high-detail metadata defining them as aged anodized aluminium extrusion.
findingsAndCorrections.correction: All active base rail members are rebound to the same final anodized-aluminium material family as the detailed rail/window extrusion hierarchy.

findingsAndCorrections.finding: The visible full-height RainGutter pipe inherited ConcreteDark while only its added clamps/bolts had dedicated galvanized-metal reasoning.
findingsAndCorrections.correction: The pipe body is now a dedicated non-metallic aged rigid PVC-U fallback while the separate clamp/bolt hardware remains galvanized metal. The exact manufacturer/model is explicitly unverified.

findingsAndCorrections.finding: HD_BalconySlabLip extends the reinforced-concrete balcony slab silhouette but was created with the anodized-aluminium material.
findingsAndCorrections.correction: The slab lip is rebound to the painted-RC facade material so its grazing response comes from coated concrete plus physical edge geometry, not metal.

downpipe.construction: extruded rigid PVC-U rainwater/downpipe body with separate galvanized stand-off clamps and ferrous fasteners
downpipe.mounting: mechanically retained off the facade at roughly 1.55 m intervals by the existing generated clamp hierarchy
downpipe.interfaces: pipe-to-clamp contact, clamp-to-wall anchor and pipe-wall stand-off remain geometry/contact shadow
downpipe.exposure: rain and midsummer UV on exposed face; wall-facing recess remains relatively dirtier
downpipe.aging: mild polymer chalking/bleaching and causal runoff only; no rust on PVC and no baked light response
downpipe.sourceNote: Sekisui Chemical's Eslon history documents rigid PVC rain-gutter commercialization in Japan from 1957 and long-term adoption. This supports PVC-U as a period-plausible circa-2000 generated fallback, not a claim about a specific real complex.

balconySlabLip.mounting: monolithic visual continuation of the balcony slab, not a separate metal extrusion
balconySlabLip.interfaces: slab edge/drip and rail anchorage remain physically distinct
balconySlabLip.geometryVsMaterial: slab thickness/edge break are geometry; mineral coating microstructure/chalking are PBR material response

staticReview: Actual Unity Material properties are now checked against construction-family ranges instead of trusting metadata alone.
Base rail renderers are forced onto the same anodized-aluminium material family as their high-detail construction hierarchy.
The drainage pipe and its metal clamps are now separate material classes, matching manufacture/installation causality.
The concrete balcony slab lip no longer inherits a metallic aluminium material.
The quality-scene save gate and complete 4K review packet both validate these bindings before visual scoring is allowed.
No visual score or critical-defect clearance is inferred from source values.

expectedVisualScoreImpact.material_pbr_physical_plausibility: HIGH_EXPECTED_RISK_REDUCTION: actual aluminium/galvanized/PVC/painted-RC renderer bindings now match explicit material families and plausible metallic/roughness behavior.
expectedVisualScoreImpact.geometry_construction: MEDIUM_EXPECTED: the balcony slab lip and drainage assembly now communicate correct material boundaries/interfaces instead of contradictory construction.
expectedVisualScoreImpact.period_accuracy_scene_authenticity: LOW_TO_MEDIUM_EXPECTED: rigid PVC-U drainage is a documented long-established Japanese building-material technology and is used only as a period-plausible fallback.
expectedVisualScoreImpact.lighting_shadows_reflections: MEDIUM_EXPECTED: grazing highlights should now separate metal, PVC and coated concrete through actual PBR response rather than mid-metallic ambiguity.

nextBlocker: A Unity 6000.3.0f1 editor/runner is still required to compile the new scripts, execute the scene-save material gate, verify generated MAT_AgedDownpipePVC in-engine, and produce sealed 3840x2160 hero/oblique/grazing evidence plus temporal probes.

Fix any compile/save-gate/material-binding failure before scoring.
Inspect hero/oblique/grazing 100% crops for aluminium that reads like plastic/chrome, galvanized hardware that reads painted, PVC pipe that reads metallic, and balcony slab lip that reads as metal.

Score only the sealed rendered evidence and fix the largest actual deductions first.
